response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` o GROUP BY o.account_id), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.account_id, d.A3 AS region, c.order_count, c.order_count - a.avg_count AS difference FROM counts c JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = c.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id CROSS JOIN avg_c a ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
